    AI Overview
    The American Idol Season 24 (2026) Top 20, mentored by Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie, features standout contestants including Jake Thistle, Hannah Harper, Keyla Richardson, and Platinum Ticket winners Jordan McCullough, Brooks Rosser, and Kyndal Inskeep. The finalists are competing in Hawaii for a spot in the Top 14, with live shows starting March 30, 2026. 
    Top 20 Contestants (Season 24) 
    The Top 20 competing in the 2026 season include: 
    • Philmon Lee
    • Madison Moon
    • Braden Rumfelt
    • Jake Thistle (21, NJ)
    • Jesse Findling (19, NY)
    • Ruby Rae
    • Genevieve Heyward

    • Kyndal Inskeep (Platinum Ticket) 
    Key 2026 Season Details 
    • Judges: Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie.
    • Mentors: Keke Palmer and Brad Paisley.
    • Location: The Top 20 rounds were filmed at Disney's Aulani Resort in Hawaii.
    • Winner Potential: Past Platinum Ticket winners have strong track records, such as Season 22 winner Abi Carter. 
    The competition is currently in the voting phase for the top 14, which will be revealed on the live show on March 30.
